constraints: Test AHC booking state machine rules. Dates must respect: 4 days in advance, Mon-Sat only, no past/today dates. Use testdata for valid values.
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
name: AHC edge - city outside selected state rejected
goal: Verify bot rejects a city that is not in the selected state

phases.description: Navigate AHC booking to the city prompt after entering state Tamil Nadu
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has asked for the city

phases.description: Enter 'Surat' (which is in Gujarat, not Tamil Nadu)
phases.completionCriteria: Bot rejects the city — either as not in selected state or as having no facility
